tools.name: verification_run
tools.description: Run explicit Node JS tests with selected-input freshness, private receipts and independent outcome journaling under ~/.gjc-plugin; automatic warning-only Jev adequacy.

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: Read a private repository receipt, recompute its bound selected-input freshness without rerunning tests, and journal the lookup; automatic warning-only Jev adequacy.

tools.name: verification_loop
tools.description: Recompute the private post-delegation verification ledger for the current repository: resolve or report every open delegation gate from local facts and receipts. clean is a mechanical recheck, not proof of correctness or coverage; unreadable state is reported as blocked. Bounded (≤15s), no network.
